mapper.select: /* 상품 목록 조회 */ SELECT p.products_no, p.products_nm, m.model_no, m.model_nm, CASE WHEN p.products_status = '판매중단' THEN '판매중단' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sell_products sp WHERE sp.products_no = p.products_no AND sp.use_status = '사용중' ) THEN '활' ELSE '비활' END AS products_status, IFNULL(f.file_path, '/manage/assets/imgs/theme/upload.svg') AS products_image, DATE_FORMAT(p.register_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS register_date, DATE_FORMAT(p.revision_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS revision_date FROM products p INNER JOIN model m ON p.model_no = m.model_no LEFT JOIN files f ON m.model_no = f.ref_id AND f.file_type = 'mainImage'

SELECT s.spec_no AS specNo, s.spec_nm AS specNm, ( SELECT sc.spec_content FROM model_spec_content sc WHERE sc.model_no = #{modelNo} AND sc.spec_no = s.spec_no AND sc.use_status = '사용중' LIMIT 1 ) AS specContent FROM products_spec s WHERE s.product_category_no = ( SELECT product_category_no FROM model WHERE model_no = #{modelNo} ) AND s.use_status = '사용중' ORDER BY s.spec_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products ( products_no, manager_id, model_no, item_no, product_category_no, products_nm, products_status, products_detail, register_date, revision_date ) VALUES ( #{productNo}, #{managerId}, #{modelNo}, #{itemNo}, #{categoryNo}, #{productName}, #{productStatus}, #{productDetail}, #{registerDate}, #{revisionDate} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE products
product_category_no = #{categoryNo},
item_no = #{itemNo},
model_no = #{modelNo},
products_nm = #{productName},
products_detail = #{productDetail},
revision_date = NOW()
WHERE products_no = #{productNo}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT item_no AS itemNo, item_nm AS itemNm FROM model WHERE product_category_no = #{categoryNo}
SELECT DISTINCT brand_no AS brandNo, brand_nm AS brandNm FROM model WHERE product_category_no = #{categoryNo} AND item_no = #{itemNo}
SELECT model_no AS modelNo, model_nm AS modelName FROM model WHERE product_category_no = #{categoryNo} AND item_no = #{itemNo} AND brand_no = #{brandNo}

SELECT model_no AS modelNo, manager_id AS managerId, brand_no AS brandNo, item_no AS itemNo, product_category_no AS categoryNo, model_nm AS modelName, register_date AS modelRegDate, revision_date AS modelRevDate, use_status AS useStatus FROM model WHERE model_no = #{modelNo}
SELECT product_category_no AS categoryNo, large_category AS lgCategory, middle_category AS mdCategory, small_category AS smCategory FROM products_category WHERE use_status = '사용중'

SELECT item_no AS itemNo, manager_id AS managerId, product_category_no AS categoryNo, item_nm AS itemName, register_date AS itemRegDate, revision_date AS itemRevDate, use_status AS useStatus FROM item WHERE product_category_no = #{categoryNo} AND use_status = '사용중'

SELECT b.brand_no AS brandNo, b.manager_id AS managerId, b.brand_nm AS brandName, b.register_date AS brandRegDate, b.revision_date AS brandRevDate FROM brand b JOIN model m ON b.brand_no = m.brand_no WHERE m.item_no = #{itemNo} AND m.product_category_no = #{categoryNo} AND b.use_status = '사용중' GROUP BY b.brand_no

SELECT p.products_no AS productNo, p.product_category_no AS categoryNo, p.item_no AS itemNo, m.brand_no AS brandNo, p.model_no AS modelNo, p.products_nm AS productName, p.products_detail AS productDetail, p.products_status AS productStatus, p.register_date AS registerDate, p.revision_date AS revisionDate FROM products p LEFT JOIN model m ON p.model_no = m.model_no WHERE p.products_no = #{productNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET products_status = '판매중단', revision_date = NOW() WHERE products_no = #{productNo}
UPDATE products SET products_status = '비활', revision_date = NOW() WHERE products_no = #{productNo}
mapper.select: /* 상품 중복 확인 */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE model_no = #{modelNo}
